manifest.change_reason: Starter catalogue migrated from the initial LJUP rule catalogue.

rules.title: Physical plan sets and folding
rules.requirement: Four plan sets and the required A4 folding must be confirmed physically.
rules.standard_comment: Confirm physical set quantity and folding.

rules.title: Approved planning permission plan
rules.requirement: An approved Planning Permission plan must be included.
rules.standard_comment: Provide the approved Planning Permission plan.

rules.title: Building plan site plan fallback
rules.requirement: Provide the approved Building Plan site plan where no approved Planning Permission plan exists.
rules.standard_comment: Confirm the applicable approved site-plan document.

rules.title: Road and drainage plan
rules.requirement: Provide an approved Road and Drainage Plan or the stated certification and supporting letter.
rules.standard_comment: Provide the applicable road and drainage evidence.

rules.title: TNB pole-position confirmation
rules.requirement: TNB confirmation for the agreed pole position must be located and verified.
rules.standard_comment: Officer verification of TNB confirmation is required.

rules.title: LJUP review forms
rules.requirement: The applicable LJUP general and special review forms must be submitted.
rules.standard_comment: Submit the applicable LJUP review forms.

rules.title: Four site photographs
rules.requirement: Four actual site photographs from different directions must be present; a declaration alone is insufficient.
rules.standard_comment: Upload four direct site photographs from different directions.

rules.title: First-submission payment document
rules.requirement: Where applicable, an RM250 first-submission payment document is required; registration or demand is not proof of payment.
rules.standard_comment: Verify the applicable fee and settlement independently.

rules.title: Subsequent-submission payment document
rules.requirement: Where applicable, an RM500 subsequent-submission payment document is required.
rules.standard_comment: Verify the submission round, applicable fee, and settlement.

rules.title: Submitter identity, signature and stamp
rules.requirement: The submitter name, address, signature and stamp must be visibly present; authenticity remains manual.
rules.standard_comment: Verify submitter particulars and authenticity.

rules.title: Complete project title
rules.requirement: The project title must state the scheme, lot, district and mukim consistently.
rules.standard_comment: Complete and align the project title across documents.

rules.title: Prescribed symbols and colours
rules.requirement: Use prescribed symbols and colours for existing and proposed lighting.
rules.standard_comment: Show the prescribed legend, symbols and colours.

rules.title: Luminaire orientation
rules.requirement: Show the direction or orientation of every proposed luminaire.
rules.standard_comment: Show luminaire direction clearly.

rules.title: Location plan and proposed site
rules.requirement: Provide a location plan and identify the proposed site in red.
rules.standard_comment: Add the location plan and proposed-site indication.

rules.title: Pole and luminaire schedule
rules.requirement: State total pole quantity, pole types, luminaire types and wattages.
rules.standard_comment: Provide the complete pole and luminaire schedule.

rules.title: Complete photometric proposal
rules.requirement: Submit a complete photometric proposal with pole height, arm size, spacing and wattage.
rules.standard_comment: Submit and align the complete photometric proposal.

rules.title: Existing main-road street lights
rules.requirement: Show all existing street-light poles along the main road at the development boundary.
rules.standard_comment: Show existing main-road street-light poles.

rules.title: Neighbouring existing lights
rules.requirement: Show neighbouring existing lights with height, arm length and wattage.
rules.standard_comment: Label neighbouring existing lighting details.

rules.title: Main-road access and lighting
rules.requirement: Clearly show the access from the main road and existing street lights.
rules.standard_comment: Show main-road access and existing lighting clearly.

rules.title: Accepted installation design
rules.requirement: Proposed installation and pole design must follow the applicable accepted guidance.
rules.standard_comment: Officer confirmation of technical design acceptance is required.

rules.title: Approved limit of work
rules.requirement: Proposed lights must remain within the approved limit of work and supply constraints must be addressed.
rules.standard_comment: Verify the limit of work and supply arrangement.

rules.title: Resubmission amendments
rules.requirement: A resubmitted plan must show proposed or recommended pole-position amendments clearly.
rules.standard_comment: Identify resubmission amendments clearly.

rules.title: Lighting at hazards and activity points
rules.requirement: Provide adequate lighting at traffic hazards and activity points.
rules.standard_comment: Officer engineering judgement is required for lighting adequacy.

rules.title: Road offset and Universal Design route
rules.requirement: Feeder pillars and poles must observe the stated offset and avoid the Universal Design route.
rules.standard_comment: Verify exact offset and Universal Design clearance.

rules.title: Photometric summary and detail
rules.requirement: Submit complete photometric summary and detail including pole height, arm size, spacing and wattage.
rules.standard_comment: Provide complete and consistent photometric details.

rules.title: Lamp quantity and wattage consistency
rules.requirement: Lamp wattage and quantity must match between the plan and photometric report.
rules.standard_comment: Align lamp wattages and quantities across both sources.

rules.title: Project identity consistency
rules.requirement: Project title, phase, lot, mukim and developer must be consistent across documents.
rules.standard_comment: Resolve project-identity inconsistencies.

rules.title: Declared attachments actually present
rules.requirement: Attachments declared in a cover letter or checklist must actually be present in the package.
rules.standard_comment: Upload every declared attachment; a declaration is not the attachment.

rules.title: Payment amount and submission round
rules.requirement: The payment-document amount must match the inferred submission round; settlement remains manual.
rules.standard_comment: Verify submission round, amount and paid status independently.

rules.title: Form applicability consistency
rules.requirement: Applicability selections in consultant forms must match the proposed lighting system.
rules.standard_comment: Align form applicability selections with the proposed design.
